tier_description: Pure arithmetic on the generated style. No renderer, no GPU. Says nothing about Tier B.

implementation.isolation: A separate executable target beside BettaMetalLab. Neither imports the other. BettaMetalLab is held to parity with the locked production presets; this target must have zero appearance decisions in its generator, and the two claims would be unreadable if mixed in one module.

constitution.note: Byte-identical to the file the Kotlin implementation reads. Two independent implementations consuming one file is what makes the portability claim measurable.

environment.xcode: not installed; Command Line Tools only
environment.metal_offline_compiler: unavailable (xcrun metal not present). Not required for this tier, which draws nothing. Relevant to Tier B, which must compile shaders at runtime via makeLibrary(source:) as BettaRenderer.swift already does.

no_retry_path: Contracts are evaluated after generation and only counted. No code path discards a seed and draws another.
caveats: This tier draws nothing. It cannot speak to whether any seed looks like anything.
Contracts were not exercised by negative controls at the time of this run.
